steps: Boil a big pot of salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Brown the ground turkey in the oil in a large pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic and cook a few minutes until the onion softens.
Pour in the pasta sauce, add a splash of pasta water, and simmer about 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Bake the garlic toast following the box directions while the sauce simmers.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce and serve with the toast and the garden salad on the side.
recipes.title: Turkey Spaghetti with Meat Sauce

steps: Cook the onion in the oil for a few minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned all the way through, breaking it into small crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a splash of water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave.
Fill each tortilla with turkey, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and a spoon of sour cream.
recipes.title: Turkey Tacos

steps: Melt half the butter in a big skillet and cook the potato cubes over medium heat, stirring now and then, until they are golden and almost tender, about 15 minutes. Set them aside.
In the same pan, cook the pork cubes until browned on the outside and cooked through. Set aside with the potatoes.
Add the rest of the butter and the onion and cook a few minutes until soft.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for a minute, then slowly stir in the milk to make a simple sauce. Let it bubble until it thickens a little.
Put the pork and potatoes back in the pan, add the garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir everything together so the sauce coats it all. Cook 2 more minutes.
Cook the green beans following the bag directions and serve on the side.
recipes.title: Cubed Pork and Potato Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the pork cubes in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and green beans until the beans are tender and a little browned at the edges.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, then put the pork back in.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir everything together for a minute. Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Pork and Green Bean Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the chicken pieces in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion and cook a few minutes until soft.
Stir in the peas and carrots and cook until heated through.
Add the cooked rice, soy sauce, and garlic powder. Stir everything together and cook 2 more minutes so the flavors mix.
recipes.title: Chicken and Rice Skillet

ingredients.note: cooked and cooled, day-old works best

steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil in a big skillet or wok, then set them aside.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the onion and the frozen peas and carrots until tender.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry a few minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir so the rice colors evenly.
Fold the eggs back in, cook one more minute, and serve.
recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice

steps: Heat the soup and milk together in a pot, stirring now and then, until hot. Do not boil it hard.
Butter the outside of the bread slices and build sandwiches with 2 slices of cheese each.
Cook the sandwiches in a skillet over medium heat until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted, a few minutes per side.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve with the soup for dipping.
recipes.title: Tomato Soup and Grilled Cheese

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big pot for a few minutes until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the tomato soup plus a can of water and stir well.
Simmer gently about 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until a little thicker. Taste and add salt if it needs it.
Serve in bowls topped with cheddar and a spoon of sour cream.
recipes.title: Turkey Chili

ingredients.note: broken in half so it fits the dish

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil the spaghetti until just tender and drain it.
Brown the ground turkey in the oil in a big pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the pasta sauce, milk, and garlic powder and let it simmer 5 minutes.
Mix the spaghetti through the sauce, then spread it in a baking dish.
Cover the top with the shredded cheddar and bake about 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
recipes.title: Cheesy Turkey Pasta Bake

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the chicken strips in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry the frozen vegetables until tender and any water has cooked off.
Put the chicken back in, add the soy sauce and garlic powder, and stir for a minute.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Chicken Stir Fry with Frozen Vegetables

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the pork cubes in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and the frozen peas and carrots until tender.
Put the pork back in, add the soy sauce and garlic powder, and stir for a minute.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Pork Stir Fry with Peas and Carrots

ingredients.note: part for the meatloaf, part for the potatoes
spread on top as a glaze

steps: Heat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix the ground turkey, egg, bread crumbs, half the milk, onion, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl with your hands until just combined.
Shape the mix into a loaf in a baking dish and spread the pasta sauce over the top.
Bake about 45 minutes, until the middle is cooked through and no longer pink.
While it bakes, boil the potatoes until tender, then mash them with the butter and the rest of the milk.
Cook the green beans following the bag directions and serve everything together.
recipes.title: Turkey Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes
